u0: The agent has not yet acquired the key, so the door remains locked and the goal is unreachable. Current objective: locate the yellow key on the starting side and pick it up while keeping empty hands available. Picking up the key advances to u1; any other action, including dropping it before ever acquiring it, stays in u0.
u1: The agent is carrying the yellow key but has not yet opened the door. Current objective: navigate to the yellow door and toggle it while holding the key. Opening the door advances to u2. If the agent drops the key while the door stays closed, that loss event returns it to u0, where the key must be found and picked up again.
u2: The door is open and the agent may or may not still be carrying the key. Current objective: travel through the open doorway and reach the green goal in the bottom-right corner; no key drop is required. Reaching the goal advances to the terminal state u3. Toggling the open door shut reverses progress back to u1, requiring the door to be opened again.
u3: Terminal success state: the agent has stood on the goal after the door was opened, ending the episode. No further actions are needed; this state absorbs all further transitions.
